name: Jasmine
source:
Jasmine, at the beginning of the visual novel, is a first-year student at Kobukan Academy, though she's a year older than the rest of her class. She was held back a year due to health issues, which contribute to her frail appearance and meek nature. She yearns for the outdoors and oftentimes goes against better interests by venturing out alone.

Jasmine was first introduced in Pokémon Gold and Pokémon Silver versions.
